sentences.text: The genus Tenuicruris, whose name means 'slender leg' in Latin, includes just one species.
This single species is known from a nearly complete left tibiotarsus measuring exactly 6.54 centimeters long.
The bone features a deep groove on its outer side and flared ends when viewed from behind.
Matt A. White and colleagues named this new genus and species in 2026 from fossils found near Richmond, Queensland.
The holotype was discovered inside a fish mash layer and now resides at the Kronosaurus Korner Museum.
Scientists classify Tenuicruris as an enantiornithean bird that does not belong to the Pengornithidae family.
This animal lived during the Albian age of the Early Cretaceous period.
Its exact position within the Enantiornithes group remains unclear, creating a large polytomy in evolutionary trees.
